title: A Physics-Informed Neuro-Fuzzy Framework for Quantum Error Attribution
summary: As quantum processors scale beyond 100 qubits, distinguishing software bugs from stochastic hardware noise becomes a critical diagnostic challenge. We present a neuro-fuzzy framework that addresses this attribution problem by combining Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference Systems (ANFIS) with physics-grounded feature engineering. We introduce the Bhattacharyya veto, a hard constraint calibrated to the empirically characterized noise floor of the device, which classifies as buggy any output distribution whose divergence from the ideal exceeds what the device's noise produces under normal operation.…
